batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved CamScanner scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2016-2017-set2.pdf (8 pp.). LABEL MISMATCH: the Drive listing names this file Set-2, but the paper's own printed header carries the boxed set label 'সেট-০৩' — the printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2016-2017-set3 and the mismatch is flagged here and in EXTRACTION_NOTES_D1617.md. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'Ans: X' key; option labels are Latin 'A.'-'D.'. Printed header: session ২০১৬-২০১৭, D-ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), 60 minutes, full marks 80. The compilation prints no subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content (Biology split into Botany/Zoology by content block: Botany = printed Q13-34, Zoology = Q59-80; Chemistry = Q35-58), preserving printed order and numbering throughout. One question (Q45) carries the compilation's printed 'Ans-Nill' no-correct-option disposition. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi renders read as quadrant tiles; render integrity was verified by file hash and local-OCR spot checks (see EXTRACTION_NOTES_D1617.md). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
